title: Touching the reactor's repulsive field

tellings.quote: And it'll produce a gravitational field around it and you can push on it and you

plain: The power source of an alien craft made a gravity field around itself that you could physically push against with your hand, according to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on such craft between 1987 and 1989 at a hidden site in Nevada called S4. He describes it from his own hands-on experience: "it'll produce a gravitational field around it and you can push on it," which, if true, would mean the machine controlled gravity directly.
